baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun at word 1 is qualified by the abundance adjective at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: Agreeable produce is presented as numerically plentiful: the adjective enlarges the available stock while the noun keeps that stock edible and desirable.

activation_trace.role: Supplies desirable fruit as the concrete substance whose stock is enlarged.
Supplies numerical increase and makes plenitude the phrase's explicit measure.

changed_reading.before: Fruit appears as one item in a surrounding list.
changed_reading.after: The item is specifically an enlarged supply of agreeable produce.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The semantic range of word 1 includes enjoyed well-being, while word 2 can image abundance as an aggregation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can measure more than pieces of produce: gathered fruit becomes a concentrated field of delight, joining material plenty to the eater's pleased state.

activation_trace.role: Supplies inward pleasure and enjoyment as the experiential effect carried by the fruit.
Supplies concentration into a gathered mass, making delight spatially and materially dense.

changed_reading.before: Many fruit denotes a large count.
changed_reading.after: The phrase also evokes a concentrated abundance of enjoyed well-being.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 has a branch of witty, pleasant conversation, and word 2 has a branch of copious speech.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots permit a secondary social register in which plentiful fruit resonates with plentiful convivial talk.

activation_trace.role: Supplies sociable wit and pleasant talk as a latent resonance of the fruit noun.
Supplies copious speech, allowing the adjective to amplify the conversational resonance.

changed_reading.before: The phrase describes only edible quantity.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, edible plenty carries an echo of abundant convivial speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated companion-and-right frame assigns the fruit abundance to a durable social body marked by blessing; plenty is shared provision rather than an ownerless heap.

activation_trace.role: Supplies enjoyed well-being as the benefit received by the framed community.
Supplies the enlarged provision whose social allocation is being inferred.
Supplies repeated companionship and opens a collective frame for the intervening provisions.
Supplies blessing as the quality attached to the recipient group.
Closes the sequence with the same companionship, confirming its communal scope.
Restates blessing at the closing edge and brackets the abundance within it.

structural_cues: 56:27 and 56:38 repeat the same recipient phrase around the provision sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship and blessing at both edges; I assign the intervening abundance to that shared group. A live alternative is that the repeated label identifies recipients without changing the internal sense of abundance.

changed_reading.before: Abundance is a quantity of fruit.
changed_reading.after: Abundance is blessed provision held in common by an enduring companion-group.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blunted impediments and deliberately joined layers turn sheer quantity into cultivated density: the produce is plentiful because its environment is ordered and made usable.

activation_trace.role: Keeps the inferred system anchored in edible, desirable produce.
Supplies gathered concentration rather than an unstructured count.
Supplies removal or blunting of sharp obstruction, making the abundance usable.
Supplies the tree-bearing material setting in which dense produce can be organized.
Supplies orderly joining and layering as the arrangement of the plentiful yield.

structural_cues: The two preceding tree phrases pair a material noun with a participle describing its prepared condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies de-sharpening, a tree, and ordered joining; I infer cultivation as the arrow connecting those conditions to fruit density. They could instead remain independent scenic descriptions.

changed_reading.before: Many fruit is an unstructured numerical surplus.
changed_reading.after: It is a harm-reduced, deliberately ordered density of usable produce.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective shade extended through time and continuously delivered water form a sustaining ecology; fruit abundance becomes ongoing yield rather than a static pile.

activation_trace.role: Supplies produce as the output of the inferred sustaining ecology.
Supplies growth in quantity as the ecology's visible result.
Supplies sheltering protection as one condition preserving the yield.
Supplies connected extension and replenishing support rather than a momentary condition.
Supplies water delivered by irrigation or pouring as a material input.
Supplies persistence to the water flow and makes replenishment ongoing.

structural_cues: Extended shade and poured water immediately precede the focus phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, extension, water delivery, and persistence; I supply the causal arrow from those inputs to recurring fruit. A live alternative is a noncausal catalogue of pleasures.

changed_reading.before: The fruit is abundant at the depicted moment.
changed_reading.after: The fruit is an ongoing yield supported by a continuously provisioned ecology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following coordinated negations cancel both temporal depletion and social blockage, converting 'many' from a large finite count into uninterrupted, unobstructed availability.

activation_trace.role: Identifies desirable produce as what remains available.
Supplies the initial quantitative plenty that the negations remeasure.
Supplies cessation and ending, which the first negation removes from the fruit.
Supplies a barrier between a person and a desired thing, which the second negation removes.

structural_cues: The two feminine singular participles in 56:33 continue the description of the feminine fruit noun through parallel negation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct grammatical continuation plus negated ending and barrier; I distinguish temporal continuity from access and let both qualify abundance. The two negations could also be read as near-synonymous intensification.

changed_reading.before: Many fruit means a large but potentially exhaustible stock.
changed_reading.after: Its abundance consists in never being seasonally cut off and never being withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expressive affection among equals gives social traction to the focus roots' latent speech branches: material fruitfulness coexists with a profusion of intimate, lucid conversation.

activation_trace.role: Supplies pleasant conversational wit as the focus phrase's secondary register.
Supplies copious speech as the way abundance operates in that register.
Supplies lucid expression and makes the conversational resonance more than sound play.
Supplies loving social orientation as the tone of the abundant exchange.
Supplies equality in age and companionship as the relation supporting mutual conversation.

structural_cues: 56:37 places expressive affection and peer equality within the same recipient sequence as the fruit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pleasant-talk and copious-speech branches in the focus plus expressive, loving peers later; I infer a social resonance across the list. The safer alternative restricts 56:37 to persons and 56:32 to food.

changed_reading.before: The conversational branch is an isolated lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding peer community activates a secondary scene of abundant affectionate conversation alongside abundant fruit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathered groups at both temporal ends rescale the fruit: its abundance is provision adequate for a community spanning earlier and later cohorts, not luxury defined by exclusion.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the concrete provision whose recipient scale is expanded.
Supplies enough numerical growth to match the gathered populations.
Supplies the first gathered group as a collective consumer rather than an isolated recipient.
Supplies temporal beginning and precedence for one edge of the recipient span.
The split-root succession branch supplies movement from one cohort to the next.
Supplies another gathered group and repeats collective scale at the later edge.
Supplies laterness after the first and completes the temporal span.

structural_cues: 56:39-40 repeat the same group noun while changing only the cohort term from first to later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two gathered cohorts and a first-to-later sequence; I infer that the preceding plenty is scaled to their inclusive provision. Alternatively, cohort size and fruit quantity may be independent assurances.

changed_reading.before: Abundance is measured against individual appetite.
changed_reading.after: Abundance is provision scaled to gathered communities across temporal cohorts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the focus root's pre-birth milk branch into nearby creation and first-birth imagery; it remains anchored in the fruit noun and abundance adjective, but downstream prose should present it only as a reproductive material analogy, not as the phrase's lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The fruit root's pre-parturition milk branch and the abundance adjective permit an image of swelling generative readiness.

activation_trace.role: Supplies good milk appearing near birth as the unusual generative analogue for fruitfulness.
Supplies increase as fullness approaching renewed production.
Supplies conception and growing pregnancy as a nearby generative trigger.
Supplies transformation into a renewed condition.
Supplies first birth and first production as the renewal endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The phrase depicts a completed stock of fruit.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, abundance looks pregnant with renewed first yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps furnishings onto orchard form; it remains anchored in fruit plus gathered abundance and is reinforced by ordered layering, but downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial echo in which produce becomes inhabitable canopy, not identify fruit with bedding.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Fruit at word 1 and aggregated plenty at word 2 can be spatialized as a dense overhead spread.

activation_trace.role: Supplies actual produce as the material that forms the imagined canopy.
Supplies aggregation dense enough to be perceived as a spatial layer.
Supplies natural bodies layered one above another as the bridge to canopy form.
Supplies broad spreading as the horizontal extent of the fruit-bearing layer.
Supplies elevation and relocates the dense spread overhead.

changed_reading.before: Abundant fruit is a consumable inventory.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its ordered density also forms an elevated, inhabitable spread of provision.

strongest_changes: The paired negations in 56:33 redefine quantity as uninterrupted and unobstructed access.
Extended shelter and persistent water turn static plenty into sustained yield.
The repeated companion-and-right frame makes abundance communal and blessed.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots support material, affective, spatial, and conversational abundance at once; the local sequence then converts count into an ecology of ordered production, durable access, and shared enjoyment.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link from shade and water to recurring yield is reader-supplied rather than grammatically asserted.
The conversational activation depends on branch resonance across adjacent human descriptions.
The regenerative and canopy readings are intentionally retained as cross-domain analogies, not lexical equivalents.
